owner_confirmed_facts: The platform with steps seen in photos is the stair to the mezzanine.
White rectangles at the top-left of F01 are paintings on the north wall.
F01 is a venue sample, not a fixed plan; tables can seat up to 14.
DJ option 3 on the mezzanine edge may be represented as a non-navigable placement spot.
Raised floor covers everything east of the bar to the street windows; its edge follows F01's diagonal and L line.
Main entrance: street door in the south-east corner into a corridor under the mezzanine; the corridor opens into the room at the stair landing.
Mezzanine stair starts at that landing and climbs to the right (east) up to the wall, then to the mezzanine.
South wall has the kitchen behind it; the kitchen pass is an opening in that wall. The mezzanine sits above the kitchen and corridor.
Dance floor and sweetheart table are in the full-height room, not under the mezzanine; the couple sits against the south (kitchen) wall.
Communal high table and bar stools are removed for the wedding.
